QuestInfo.0: #p2410008# spotted an old scroll at the foot of the #b#p2410006##k. It seems to have a strange shimmer to it. He decides to grab it.
QuestInfo.1: Alpha took care of the #o9300744# monsters quickly enough, but he needed to get back to #b#m321000100##k before he aroused suspicions. He'd have to take the scroll with him.
QuestInfo.2: The scroll proved to be more confusing than helpful. Maple World. The Black Mage. The Transcendents. The Goddess Rhinne... and her child. #p2410008#'s feelings stirred at these strange tales, though he would not have time to look further...
